answer.headline: Visit a private clinic for fastest care; public emergency is an option if symptoms worsen.
answer.summary: As a non-EU visitor, you can use public emergency services but must pay the full actual cost, which is significantly higher than private clinic fees that travel insurance typically covers. Private clinics offer quick care, transparent pricing, and direct insurance handling, which is often best for visitors.

primary.title: Mehiläinen or Terveystalo private clinics (Helsinki central branches)
primary.when: Today or next available; no need to wait until Monday.

facts.text: A doctor's appointment at Mehiläinen costs from 95.80€ for 20 min; at Terveystalo, about 128.73€ for 20 min on Saturdays (price includes weekend surcharge).
facts.quote: Consultation visit, 20 min Price per visit. Book an appointment with a general practitioner | from 95,80 € Without Kela reimbursement from 103,80 €

facts.text: You can book online, by phone, or walk into the main emergency clinics; bring your ID and insurance policy details.
facts.quote: You can book an appointment with a general practitioner either online or by phone. You can also easily access Digital Clinic around the clock.

alternatives.title: HUS Emergency Department (public hospital emergency)
alternatives.when: If your fever or sore throat sharply worsens or you have severe difficulty swallowing or breathing, go to HUS Malmi or Meilahti emergency.

facts.text: Non-residents pay the actual cost of treatment at HUS Emergency: 71.30€ for an emergency doctor visit on weekends.
facts.quote: General practitioner or nurse appointment and remote appointment on weekdays between 8:00 p.m. and 8:00 a.m., Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays EUR 71.30

facts.text: Clients who do not have a municipality of residence in Finland or who are not considered to be comparable to residents of the municipality shall be charged a fee corresponding to the actual costs of treatment, unless otherwise stipulated by an international agreement binding Finland or by European Union legislation.

bring.quote: Arrive at the appointment 10 minutes before the scheduled time. You can check in using the OmaMehiläinen app, by showing your a valid identity document (identity card, passport, or driver's license) at the check-in kiosk, or by checking in at the service desk.
